groundTruth.sql: SELECT d.department_id,d.department_name,r.n,r.salary_total,m.first_name||' '||m.last_name FROM (SELECT department_id,COUNT(*) n,SUM(salary) salary_total,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC,department_id) rn FROM hr.employees WHERE department_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY department_id) r JOIN hr.departments d ON d.department_id=r.department_id JOIN hr.employees m ON m.employee_id=d.manager_id WHERE r.rn=2

turns: On d1, rank HR departments by employee count descending, breaking ties by department ID ascending. Give the top three department IDs, names and counts.

For the second department in that ranking, report its ID, name, employee count, exact salary total and manager full name (first name, space, last name). Keep the same count-based ranking rather than ranking by salary.

groundTruth.sql: SELECT w.warehouse_id,w.warehouse_name,l.city,c.country_name,r.region_name FROM (SELECT warehouse_id,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY SUM(quantity_on_hand) DESC,warehouse_id) rn FROM oe.inventories GROUP BY warehouse_id) q JOIN oe.warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id=q.warehouse_id JOIN hr.locations l ON l.location_id=w.location_id JOIN hr.countries c ON c.country_id=l.country_id JOIN hr.regions r ON r.region_id=c.region_id WHERE q.rn=2

turns: On d1 in OE, rank warehouses by total quantity on hand descending, ties by warehouse ID ascending. Give the top three IDs, names and total quantities.
For the second warehouse from that ranking, report its ID and name, city, country name and region name by following its location relationships. Keep the stock-quantity ranking from the previous turn.
